name: fuego-atomic-openapi-endpoint-mounting
instr:
go-fuego cannot publish its OpenAPI spec and UI endpoints atomically across native, Echo, Gin, and gorilla/mux routers. Make mounting collision-aware, portable at startup, and safe to retry while preserving registration, disabled modes, middleware effects, responses, and hidden routes.

`github.com/go-fuego/fuego` exports `OpenAPIEndpointKind`, `OpenAPIMountState`, `OpenAPICollisionMode`, `OpenAPIEndpoint`, `OpenAPIMountPlan`, `OpenAPIMountPolicy`, `OpenAPIMountEntry`, `OpenAPIMountReport`, `OpenAPIMountError`, `OpenAPIMountError.Error`, `WithOpenAPIMountPolicy`, `Engine.OpenAPIMountPlan`, `Engine.MountOpenAPIRoutes`, `Engine.RegisterOpenAPIRoutes`, and `Server.MountOpenAPI`; `github.com/go-fuego/fuego/extra` exports `OpenAPIHandler.MountOpenAPI`.

`OpenAPIEndpointKind` contains `OpenAPIEndpointSpec = iota` and `OpenAPIEndpointUI`. `OpenAPIMountState` contains `OpenAPIMounted = iota`, `OpenAPIReused`, and `OpenAPIOmitted`. `OpenAPICollisionMode` contains `OpenAPIRejectCollision = iota` and `OpenAPIReuseCompatible`.

An Engine from `NewEngine`, configured with `EngineOption` values such as `WithResponseContentType`, must return enabled specification and UI intentions from `Engine.OpenAPIMountPlan` in that order, regardless of registration order, including disabled-mode omissions. Reject collisions or reuse explicitly compatible endpoints without partial publication. Report every intention in plan order as mounted, reused, or omitted.
